verses.1: And you, son of man, take for yourself a measuring rod. Use it to measure the land. Take it and measure your father’s house and your elders. Then take some weights and weigh them on your scales.
verses.2: The three came out and lit the city on fire, during the days when the city was full of life. They took the three and burned them near their surroundings. The three were then thrown into the air, and Arik followed after them.
verses.3: And you took a little bit from there, and you threw them with your wings.
verses.4: And from them, you shall take some and throw them into the fire. You shall burn them with fire. From there, fire will come out, and it will spread throughout all the houses of Israel.
verses.5: Thus said Adonai Yehovah: “Jerusalem shall be located within the lands of those nations, and around its surroundings.”
verses.6: And he made his laws a source of harm for the nations, and his laws became a source of destruction for those lands around him. For in his laws, there was no justice; his laws did not follow any rules at all.
verses.7: Therefore, as the Lord says: “My God, why have you not followed My laws? Why have you not obeyed My judgments? You have not followed the laws of the nations around you.”
verses.8: Therefore, this is what the Lord Yahweh said: “I am upon you. I have also made judgments in your midst, for the eyes of the nations.”
verses.9: And I have done to you what I never did before, and what I will never do either. All your sufferings are due to this.
verses.10: Therefore, fathers shall eat from their children’s bodies, and children shall eat from their fathers’ bodies. I have made laws for you, and I have divided all your rest among all souls.
verses.11: Therefore, I say to Adonai Yehovah: If you do not heal my sacred things from all their damage and destruction, then I will also be destroyed. My eyes will not be able to see anything anymore, and I will also be lost.
verses.12: The first two will die from hunger and thirst. The third will fall around you in destruction. And the fourth will be lost forever, with no one to help it.
verses.13: And I will pour out my love upon them; I will comfort them. Let them know that I am Jehovah. I speak in my love, in my compassion. I will pour out my love upon them.
verses.14: And I will bring you to destruction and shame in the nations around you, in the eyes of all those who see them.
verses.15: And it shall be a disgrace and a shame for those nations who are around you. I, the LORD, have spoken these words.
verses.16: In my judgment, I will send those who are causing you to suffer from hunger. I will send them to destroy you. Hunger will overcome you, and I have prepared food for you.
verses.17: And I will send upon you hunger and bad health, and sleep and blood will pass through you. I, the LORD, will bring destruction upon you. This is what I have said.
